dish: Build-your-own cast-iron skillet bowls and pierogi
w: Canal Fulton bar and grill from the DP Jackson Steakhouse team. Reviewed by the Canton Repository ('Skillet bowls, pierogi impress') and picked in Visit Canton's Stark11 '11 must-do experiences in Canal Fulton'.

address: 122 Cherry St E, Canal Fulton, OH 44614
dish: Patty melt and the tavern smash burger with steak-fry chips
w: Neighbourhood tavern in historic Canal Fulton with a patio and a family-tree wall tracing the Miller and Doan families. The Canton Repository's review called its patty melt one of the best in a long time; listed by Visit Canton.

dish: From-scratch pasta and wood-fired pizza in a 52-seat 'nonna's kitchen'
w: Opened July 1, 2025 by Mandy Yannucci (whose father was born in Sicily; named for her nonna) and chef Emily Hansford. Featured by Akron Life ('Authentic Italian Eats in Downtown Kent') and reviewed by The Portager.

dish: Hot corned-beef, pastrami and roast-beef sandwiches and matzo-ball soup
w: Downtown Akron deli feeding office workers and University of Akron students. Voted Best Deli (#1) in Akron Life's Best of the City 2025 and in the Akron Beacon Journal's downtown weekday-lunch guide.
